description: Attack Path Visualization (app/services/attack_path) input. The graph is built by the real AttackPathGraphBuilder from the persisted correlation, its members, the linked detections, the linked risk assessment, and the threat-intel indicators/lookups that share the correlated event ids. No node, edge, ordering or field is written here.
properties: Every node and edge is derived from a persisted record; a missing surface degrades the graph and is reported in `limitation`, never silently dropped.
Nodes and edges are ordered deterministically by (surface priority, node_id) and edge_id.
The graph is truncated at the real bounds (120 nodes / 240 edges) and `truncated` is set; truncation is never silent.
Each node/edge carries a source_reference back to the persisted table and row it came from, plus evidence_references where the schema defines them.
